info.name: Multi-Courier Integration Platform
info.description:
Unified, courier-agnostic logistics API.

Set `baseUrl` and `apiKey` in the collection variables. `order_id` and `batch_id` are captured automatically by the create requests, so the folders can be run top to bottom.

Every request body is our own normalized schema — the caller never sees a courier payload. Switching `courier_partner` between "urbanebolt" and "mock" is the only change needed to route an identical order to a different carrier.

request.description: Liveness plus a database round trip. Unauthenticated so an orchestrator can probe it.
Read straight from the adapter registry. A newly added adapter appears here with no code change, which is the quickest way to confirm a plug-in worked.

request.description: The identical payload with one field changed. Demonstrates that the consumer contract is truly courier-agnostic, and works offline.
Fetches live status from the courier and appends any new scans to the append-only tracking history. Against MockCourier the shipment advances one step per call.
Safe to repeat — an already-cancelled shipment returns 200, not an error.

request.description:
Accepts up to 100 orders and answers 202 with a batch_id immediately; processing happens in the background with bounded concurrency.

This sample deliberately mixes couriers and includes three failures — a duplicate order_id, a bad pincode and an unknown courier — to show per-order partial success.
Live progress plus a per-order result with a reason for every failure.

Remove the x-api-key header before sending.
